records.subject: Welcome aboard, Union Media
records.body:
Hi Zara,

Your Wrenfield account is live. A simple way to start: one project, a handful of real tasks, then an invite to a teammate. No need to overthink the setup.

Here if you need anything.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

decisions.rationale: First project reached 2026-06-24, one day before as_of, so there is fresh momentum and 8 days left in the window. But no invite sent, no replies to either outreach (email:e062aea1, email:59ab1068), and no tickets, so engagement signal is thin. Pro plan suggests real intent.

draft.subject: One next step in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Zara,

Nice to see your first project up and running. Projects are the main organizing unit in Wrenfield, and tasks live inside them, so adding a handful of real tasks is usually the quickest way to see whether it fits how Union Media works.

When you're ready, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through whichever part is least clear.

Best,
Nadia
